europe_now.title: Crimean Bridge Strikes
europe_now.summary: Russian leadership warned of severe retaliatory measures following recent Ukrainian attacks targeting the Crimean Bridge. The statement highlights escalating regional tensions and ongoing infrastructure conflict.

sources.headline: Putin vows 'far more painful' response to Ukraine's strikes on Crimean Bridge

europe_now.title: Greenland Security Agreement
europe_now.summary: Denmark has officially ratified a new security agreement concerning Greenland following sustained diplomatic pressure from the United States. The move addresses strategic Arctic defense arrangements and regional governance.

sources.headline: Denmark ratifies Greenland security deal after months of pressure by Trump

top_stories.title: European Support for Ukraine
top_stories.summary: European allies gathered in Berlin to demonstrate unified political and strategic backing for Ukraine amid ongoing conflict. The meeting emphasized continued regional cooperation and diplomatic solidarity.

sources.headline: Ukraine's European allies meet in Berlin in show of support

top_stories.title: Judicial Disputes in Poland
top_stories.summary: The Polish Supreme Court formally rejected the government's official stance regarding the Constitutional Tribunal. This decision marks a significant institutional disagreement within the national judiciary framework.

sources.headline: Polish Supreme Court rejects government’s position on Constitutional Tribunal
